title: Privacy in Context Is Being Overlooked in the Age of General-Purpose LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2610.29925v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As large language models (LLMs) continue to grow in scope and capability, privacy concerns are on the rise. Since users increasingly interact with a single general-purpose system across many distinct contexts, there is a natural tendency to pursue a one-size-fits-all solution to privacy. Unfortunately, this overlooks a crucial insight from decades of privacy research: privacy is inherently contextual. In this paper, we argue that existing work in prompt privacy is drifting towards attempts to design a unified framework, which is highly misleading and can foster a false sense of security. Furthermore, we argue that even future work in this direction needs to wrestle with fundamental tensions across various desirable properties of prompt privacy. Thus, such continued attempts towards a unified framework need to be reconsidered. We recommend three critical paths forward: application-specific deployment of LLMs, context-specific evaluation o

translated_title: 通用大语言模型时代下，情境化隐私正在被忽视
translated_abstract: 随着大型语言模型（LLM）在应用范围和能力上不断增强，隐私问题日益凸显。由于用户越来越多地在众多不同情境中与同一个通用系统进行交互，人们自然而然地倾向于追求一种“一刀切”的隐私解决方案。遗憾的是，这种做法忽视了数十年隐私研究中的一个关键洞见：隐私本质上是情境相关的。在本文中，我们论证了现有的提示隐私研究正在朝向设计统一框架的方向漂移，这种做法极具误导性，并可能营造出一种虚假的安全感。此外，我们认为即使未来沿此方向开展的研究，也必须面对提示隐私的诸多理想属性之间存在的根本性矛盾。因此，这种持续构建统一框架的尝试需要被重新审视。我们推荐三条关键的前进路径：面向特定应用的LLM部署、面向特定情境的评估等。
tldr: 本文指出隐私本质上是情境相关的，当前为LLM提示隐私构建统一框架的研究方向具有误导性并可能带来虚假安全感，应转向面向特定应用的部署与面向特定情境的评估。
en_tdlr: This paper argues that privacy is inherently contextual, and that the trend toward building a unified framework for LLM prompt privacy is misleading and fosters false security, advocating instead for application-specific deployment and context-specific evaluation.
